name: review-before-commit
description: The commit gate: independent background review runs and converges before anything lands.

interface.shortDescription: Independent review converges before any commit.
interface.longDescription: Gates every commit behind independent background review: get the tree green, launch cross-model reviewers (via rubber-duck-review when installed), triage every finding, re-review until convergence, and only then commit. Hands off to watch-ci-after-push once the commit is pushed.
defaultPrompt: Run the commit gate on my working tree.
Land this change with review first.
